item.title: Storm Austen causes power cuts and travel disruption across UK
item.body: Millions remain under yellow weather warnings for wind and rain as Storm Austen brings widespread disruption. A second storm is expected to hit Scotland and northern England on Saturday.

caption:
🔴 SON DAKİKA | ⛈️ Storm Austen causes power cuts and travel disruption across UK

Millions remain under yellow weather warnings for wind and rain as Storm Austen brings widespread disruption. A second storm is expected to hit Scotland and northern England on Saturday.
